personality_one_liner: A premium, hyper-efficient workforce management tool that feels as fast and native as Uber, prioritizing cognitive accessibility and stark monochrome contrast.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm. Always account for Safe Area at the root. Use `md` or `lg` padding inside cards. Never cramp lists; give them at least 56pt height.

do's: Use `expo-blur` over `surfaceTertiary` tint for Bottom Tab Bar and sticky headers.
Apply frosted glass to the Floating Action Button and featured cards on the Home Dashboard.
Use glass heavily for sheet handles and profile headers.
dont's: Do not apply glass to body content, form fields, or dense list rows.
Do not blur without ensuring minimum tint opacity (≥70% of surface) for text readability.

screens.name: Role Selector / Login
screens.purpose: Minimalist gateway to select Worker or Company path with FaceID/Fingerprint support.
screens.layout: Two massive `lg` radius cards (Worker vs Company) centered on screen. Pure black and white. Large typography with subtle border outlines.

screens.name: Home Dashboard (Worker)
screens.purpose: 0–3 visible widgets offering total operational clarity: Trust Score, Today's Jobs, Quick Check-in.

states.empty: Icon + short text ('No jobs today') + 'Find Jobs' primary CTA.

screens.layout: Apple's Liquid Glass translucent header. Profile greeting at top. Large Trust Score widget with Sage Green accent. A 'Smart Stack' style card for Today's Jobs. Sticky Check-in FAB.

screens.name: Search
screens.purpose: Find jobs, workers, or teams quickly.
screens.layout: Prominent search bar at top. Horizontal scrolling pill chips (`brandTertiary` bg) for filters. List view with generous spacing.

screens.name: Messages
screens.purpose: Modern chat hub for contracts and team communication.
screens.layout: Standard iOS clean chat list with large avatars. Inside: modern chat bubbles (`surfaceSecondary` vs `brandPrimary`), voice message support, document previews.

screens.name: Contracts
screens.purpose: List and digital signature flow for worker/company agreements.
screens.layout: Minimalist list. Detail view uses whitespace instead of dividers. Bottom section uses progressive disclosure for the Digital Signature canvas (native Markup style).

screens.name: Profile / Career
screens.purpose: Showcase identity, trust score, timeline, and achievements.
screens.layout: Centered top layout. Profile cover uses a glass banner. Vertical career timeline using a left border and dots. Progress charts for skills/reputation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 1 iOS-Native Clean personality. The app should feel as fast, minimal, and premium as Uber or Airbnb.

Do NOT use any blue, indigo, or purple. The entire app uses a strict Monochrome palette (Black/White) with a Sage Green accent (`#166534` light / `#4ADE80` dark) for success, progress, and Trust Scores.

Ensure all text rendered on top of imagery uses the MANDATORY gradient-to-dark scrim pattern: a vertical linear gradient from transparent to at least 70% opacity `surfaceInverse` at the bottom, with text placed in the darkest area.
For the Contracts feature, use a minimalist approach: remove unnecessary lines/dividers and use whitespace. Implement a touch-friendly drawing area for the digital signature.
The Home Dashboard must avoid clutter. Stick to '0-3 visible widgets' or a Smart Stack approach. Prioritize operational clarity over decoration.
Include subtle haptic feedback for all major interactions (check-in, tab switch, signature commit). Ensure these are explicitly wired to buttons and actions.
